business.title: What kind of business do you run?
business.description: With a few quick answers, Aphel suggests an initial setup. You can change everything later.

team.title: How many people will use Aphel?
team.description: Count everyone who serves customers and follows sales.

recommendation.title: Choose a template to start
recommendation.description: The template creates fields, pipelines, tags and views designed for your business. No data is deleted.

preview.title: Review what will be created
preview.description: Check the setup before applying it. Items that conflict with what already exists are skipped.

real_estate.label: Real estate
real_estate.description: Property sales and rentals, brokers and listings.

agency.label: Agency
agency.description: Marketing, design, development or communication for clients.

software.label: Software or SaaS
software.description: Digital product sold by subscription or license.

b2b_sales.label: Sales to companies
b2b_sales.description: A sales team selling products or services to other companies.

other.label: Other
other.description: None of the options above describes your business well.

product.label: Products
product.description: Physical or digital items sold per unit.

recurring.label: Recurring
recurring.description: Subscriptions, monthly fees or renewed contracts.

scratch.title: Start from scratch
scratch.description: Keeps Aphel's default setup. You can install a template later in Configuration packages.

preview.nothing: Nothing new to create: the organization already has everything this template brings.
preview.outdated: The organization's setup changed since the preview. Review the new version and apply again.

conflicts.description: Something with the same key and a different setup already exists. What exists stays as it is.

done.applied: Template applied. Your organization is ready.

notPending.completed: The initial setup assistant was already completed in this organization.
notPending.skipped: The initial setup assistant was skipped in this organization.
notPending.dismissed: This organization was already in use when the assistant was created, so it was not shown.

noAccess.title: No permission
noAccess.description: Only people who manage the organization settings can use the initial assistant.

settings.title: Initial assistant
settings.description: Quick questions about your business that suggest a configuration template for the organization.

details.pending: The assistant was not answered yet and shows up for administrators on their next visit.
details.dismissed: The organization was already in use when the assistant was created, so it was not shown.

settings.packagesHint: To install other templates or export the setup, use

errors.templates: Could not load the available templates.
errors.plan: Could not build the template preview.
errors.invalidTemplate: This template cannot be installed in this Aphel version.
